title: The epistemological gatekeeper in the face of cracks in the ivory tower
html: In the third decade of the 21st century, dental public health (DPH) faces an existential crisis that is not biological but informational. Whereas traditional morbidity indexes such as caries, periodontal disease, and oral cancer remain prevalent, the emerging threat to population oral health stems from an infodemic; that is, a deluge of information characterized by the rapid spread of conspiracy theories, scientific skepticism, and pseudomedicine.1
